verdict.rationale: No export or account-portability feature is documented. The only indirect path is that workspace notes, syntheses and reports are Markdown files that stay available to agents through the official MCP server, and enterprise mentions programmatic API queries, so some content could be pulled out in an open format. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all data (libraries, folders, stars, search results, notes), stated open export formats such as BibTeX, RIS, CSV or JSON, any account-exit or deletion process, and independent confirmation that data can be fully extracted.
